display_title: I Don't Like This Kind of Reverse Harem
description:
*"I don't need permission. I'm looking for a husband, not my brother or my father's husband."*

Natalie Ailesden was the most beautiful and dangerous thorny woman in the empire. I possessed her, the main character in the reverse harem game. I thought I could clear it quickly because it's a familiar game...

*"Did you clean up all the other women?"*

The flirtatious prince, Amon Luxor. Route completed; "I thought I had a purpose for my energy." The cold grand duke of the north, Roger Crawford. Route completed;

*"I taught you that if you cling to it while crying, you can have a woman's heart..."*

The crying psychopath mage, Igor. Route completed. I've captured all the male leads, but why hasn't the ending appeared?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
